data.name: Avanija
data.gender_notes: Avanija is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avanija is a Sanskrit name which is derived from the word 'Ava' meaning 'East' and 'Ni' meaning 'Goddess'. This name signifies the Goddess of the East. It is believed that the Goddess of the East brings prosperity and good fortune to one's life. The name Avanija carries the meaning “Goddess of the East” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Avanija usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the east and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Avanija is a divine name that represents the feminine energy of the Goddess of the East. It is believed that the Goddess of the East brings prosperity, good fortune, and happiness to one's life. This name is often used in Hindu rituals and prayers.
data.etymology: Avanija belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of the East.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avanija total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
